title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 9.0 security update
description: .NET 9.0 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 contains an elevation of privilege vulnerability in ASP.NET Core identified as CVE-2026-114148. This security issue allows an attacker to gain higher privileges than intended. Red Hat has released an important security update addressing this vulnerability in SDK version 9.0.123 and runtime version 9.0.22. The update is available for multiple Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 variants and related products. Users should apply the update to mitigate the risk.
